channel.title: UNICEF Job Vacancies (Filtered)
channel.description: Filtered UNICEF job vacancies: Professional (P-1 to P-5), Director (D-1/D-2), internships and fellowships.

item.title: Temporary Appointment: Legal Affairs Specialist, P-3, Office of Executive Director, New York, PAT 136853
item.description: The Legal Affairs Specialist will give recommendations and advice on a wide range of organizational activities and interests, and concern, among other things, the interaction of UNICEF with governments and other key partners as well as on strategic initiatives across UNICEF. This support helps UNICEF to take advantage of opportunities as well as safeguard the organization from risk. The Legal Office aims to identify and mitigate exposure to potential liability and financial loss, to safeguard the ability of the organization to be accountable to its stakeholders, and to preserve credibility as well as funding from member states and other donors, both public and private.

item.title: Communication and Advocacy Specialist, P-3, TA (6 months), #138683, Ouagadougou - Burkina-Faso, WCAR
item.description: UNICEF Burkina Faso's 2027—2030 programme aces strong emphasis on integrated programming, resilience of essential services, evidence generation for policy dialogue and Number/level of posts supervised: 2 advocacy, social and behaviour change, social protection, partnership development and resource leveraging. The Communication and Advocacy Specialist will help translate programme evidence and field realities into compelling advocacy, visibility and engagement products for government, donors, communities, media, young people and the wider public.

item.title: Technical Specialist, P-3, Temporary Position, 364 days, Supply Division, Copenhagen, Denmark, #00138799
item.description: Under the general guidance of the Technical Specialist P-4, the incumbent will provide technical leadership and subject-matter expertise for pharmaceutical products and related health commodities. The role will support product selection, technical specifications, tender evaluations, supplier and product assessments, quality-assurance requirements, market intelligence, documentation review and technical risk management to ensure timely procurement of quality-assured and fit-for-purpose products.

item.title: Planning Specialist (Budget & Finance), (P3), #98208, GPD/Office of Innovation/Directors Office, - Stockholm, Sweden
item.description: Join UNICEF’s Office of Innovation in Stockholm as a Planning Specialist (Budget & Finance), P-3. This role brings together planning, budgeting, grant management and financial analysis to strengthen resource management and support informed decision-making across a dynamic, multi-team environment.

item.title: Contracts Specialist (Medicines), P-3, Temporary Position, 364 days, Supply Division, Copenhagen, Denmark, #00138800
item.description: Under the general guidance of the Contracts Manager (Medicines Unit - within the Child Survival Centre (CSC), the incumbent develops and executes procurement strategies for pharmaceuticals to support special country projects, including proposing method of purchase in support of ensuring an uninterrupted, sustainable supply of affordable, quality pharmaceuticals. Focus is on securing efficient supply of pharmaceuticals, incorporation of innovation opportunities including engagement in innovation projects related to pharmaceuticals and engagement in project implementation of projects that involve pharmaceutical procurement from program countries in coordination with complex partnerships and country specific health programmes.

item.title: People and Culture Manager, P-4, Fixed Term Position, Maputo, Republic of Mozambique, #00088093
item.description: UNICEF Mozambique is looking for a People and Culture Manager to lead integrated people and culture services that enhance organizational effectiveness and strengthen the capacity of clients to deliver on their business goals and objectives. The incumbent anticipates emerging workforce and organizational needs and develops strategic, people-centered, and innovative solutions that align people management, culture, and organizational transformation priorities with business objectives.

item.title: Information Management Officer, P-2, TA, 364 days, #138647, Education Cannot Wait (ECW), UNITED Hosted Fund, Geneva, Switzerland
item.description: Education Cannot Wait (ECW) is looking for an Information Management Officer to help strengthen information management systems, information flows and data-driven decision-making across the Secretariat. Working closely with teams across ECW, the incumbent will support the collection, quality assurance, analysis, visualization and dissemination of information, while contributing to innovative information management solutions, including the responsible use of AI, to enhance internal operations, results reporting and services to partners.

item.title: Social Policy Monitoring & Evaluation Specialist (P-3), TA (364 days), #138001, Dakar, Senegal - WCAR
item.description: Senegal faces growing fiscal constraints that limit investments in social sectors, while child poverty and inequalities remain widespread. Many children continue to experience deprivations in health, education, nutrition, and social protection, further worsened by climate-related shocks. In response, UNICEF is strengthening its work on public finance for children, social protection, planning, and evidence-based policymaking. The Social Policy, Planning and Monitoring Specialist (P-3) TA plays a key role in advancing these efforts and improving outcomes for the most vulnerable children.

item.title: Health Manager, P-4, TA (6 months) #138388, Bunia, Democratic Republic of Congo - WCAR
item.description: The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is responding to its 17th Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) outbreak, confirmed in May 2026 and affecting Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu provinces. The situation remains complex and evolving, with transmission occurring in both community and health-care settings. Response efforts are led by national authorities in a context shaped by health system limitations, logistical constraints, insecurity, displacement, and diverse community perceptions influencing health-seeking behaviors. UNICEF supports the Government through a multi-sectoral approach, focusing on community engagement, surveillance, infection prevention, and the continuity of essential services for vulnerable populations. This context requires strong coordination, adaptability, and cultural sensitivity to support effective and equitable response efforts, particularly for children and at-risk communities.

item.title: Education Specialist (Emergencies), P-4, TA, 364 days, #00137696, Education Cannot Wait (ECW), UNICEF Hosted Fund, Geneva, Switzerland
item.description: Education Cannot Wait (ECW) is looking for an experienced Education Specialist (Emergencies) to join its Programme Delivery and Quality Team. Supporting the Chief of Education, the Education Specialist will oversee ECW’s portfolio of country investments and ensure alignment with ECW’s strategic approach, programme priorities, standardized programme delivery, and quality assurance approaches. The role is responsible for ensuring the effective design, implementation, monitoring, and strategic oversight of ECW’s country-level investments, while promoting coherence across country portfolios, governance processes, and technical operations. Working closely with internal and external stakeholders, the postholder will contribute to ECW’s mission to deliver quality education in emergencies and protracted crises.

item.title: Statistics & Monitoring Officer (P2), Temporary Position (364 days), #138654, OSE - Florence, Italy
item.description: The key results of the incumbent will have an impact on UNICEF's capacity to monitor and improve results for children and adolescents around the world by increasing quality and availability of evidence on mortality and demographics indicators including UNICEF’s Strategic Plan, SDGs (3.2.1 and 3.2.2) and other survival targets. The results of the duties and tasks of this position will contribute to evidence generation, global monitoring and advocacy efforts to improve child survival.

item.title: Chief Education (Learning, Skills and Engagement), (P-5), FT, #00047093, Maputo, Republic of Mozambique
item.description: Under the overall guidance of the Deputy Representative, Programmes, the Chief Education (Learning, Skills and Engagement) provides strategic leadership and oversight for UNICEF Mozambique’s LSE programme. The Chief is accountable for the quality, coherence and results of integrated strategies that improve foundational learning, expand inclusive learning and skills pathways, strengthen education system resilience and accountability, and enable adolescents and young people to participate meaningfully and transition towards further learning, work and earning opportunities.

item.title: Procurement Services Manager, P-4, Fixed Term Position, Supply Division, Copenhagen, Denmark, #00021902
item.description: Under the general guidance of the Chief, Supply Financing, responsible to ensure a proactive and systematic approach of identifying and executing business transactions in close collaboration with Country Offices in the procurement of goods and services on behalf of partners.

item.title: Security Manager, (P-4), FT, #107113, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, ESAR, (For Non-Ethiopian Nationals only)
item.description: Join UNICEF Ethiopia Country Office as a Security Manager (P4) and lead strategic security risk management in support of UNICEF's mission to deliver results for the most vulnerable children. The role provides expert security advice, oversees security operations and compliance, strengthens partnerships, and enables safe and effective programme delivery across a complex operating environment. The ideal incumbent will have an advanced degree in security, international relations, conflict analysis, or a related field, and at least eight years of international security management experience. Strong expertise in security risk management, security operations, analysis, emergency preparedness, stakeholder coordination, and team leadership is highly desirable.

item.title: Planning, Monitoring and Evaluation (PM&E) Internship, Mbabane, Eswatini (6 months only)
item.description: UNICEF Eswatini, and more specifically the Planning, Monitoring and Evaluation Section, is looking for a talented young intern who is passionate about planning, monitoring, evaluation, data management, reporting and evidence generation, and is eager to enhance their educational experience through innovative and practical hands-on work assignments.

item.title: Advocacy Specialist, P-4, Temporary Position, Rome, Italy, 364 days, Private Fund Raising and Partnerships, #00138623
item.description: Under the overall guidance and direction of the Chief of Child Rights Advocacy, the Advocacy Specialist will be responsible for supporting the National Committees in the design, implementation and monitoring of foundational advocacy and platform initiatives. The position will:1. Support foundational advocacy by National Committees, specifically CRE and child and youth participation;2. Provide support to National Committees on Platform Initiatives, either directly or through supervising dedicated consultancies when available;3. Identify and pursue opportunities for synergies among foundational advocacy and platform initiatives.

item.title: Security Specialist (P-3), FT, #88708, Nairobi - Kenya, ESAR
item.description: The Security Specialist advises and supports the Representative, Chief Field Office or Country Security Manager in fulfilling security duties and responsibilities under the UNSMS and UNICEF security policies. This role contributes to UNICEF’s mandate by enabling principled and timely delivery within acceptable levels of risk through security risk analysis, planning, preparedness, access support, incident management and implementation of appropriate risk mitigation measures. In Nairobi, the Security Specialist leads and manages a team of national security professionals to provide integrated, scalable, coordinated and responsive security support across all UNICEF offices in Nairobi, meeting the needs arising from UNICEF’s growing operational footprint, staff presence, premises, missions, events and regional programme support requirements. The Security Specialist manages and supports security activities for all UNICEF Nairobi offices and designated locations, in coordination with UNDSS, the Security Cell, other UNSMS actors and relevant partners, including under the Saving Lives Together framework.

item.title: Temporary Appointment: Staff Counsellor, P4, UNICEF Global Shared Services Centre (GSSC), Budapest, Hungary (Not for Hungarian nationals), # 00138515
item.description: The GSSC Office is looking for a Staff Counsellor who could support the overall well-being of UNICEF staff and their families in Europe HQ locations and ECAMENA region. This involves raising awareness about mental health and healthy work practices; improving the work-life balance of UNICEF staff on work-related and/or personal problems.

item.title: Urban WASH Manager, P-4, Temporary Position, Somalia, 364 days, Mogadiscio, Somalia, #00138421
item.description: The incumbent will ead UNICEF’s urban WASH portfolio, providing strategic, technical and managerial leadership to deliver high-impact water and sanitation programmes while engaging with government, development partners and international financing institutions.

item.title: People and Culture Manager, P-4, Fixed Term Position, #118832, Port Sudan, Sudan - ESAR
item.description: The P4 Human Resources Manager has a key role in leading, coordinating and quality-assurance under the overall direction of the Chief of People and Culture. The incumbent supports coherent client allocation and workload management across HRBPs; provides technical guidance and escalation support on complex or sensitive cases; promotes consistent application of policy across client groups; and ensures that business partnering is integrated with the team's functional focal-point model. Functional leads retain technical ownership and quality assurance for designated areas such as talent acquisition, employee lifecycle and entitlements, learning and performance management, workforce analytics and post management, while HRBPs coordinate client needs and refer matters requiring specialist review or approval to the relevant focal point. Given the demands of the L3 emergency, the model is deliberately flexible. The incumbent is expected to facilitate cross-pillar support during recruitment surges, staffing gaps, R&R and other absences, and periods of heightened operational demand, ensuring continuity of P&C service delivery and appropriate Officer-in-Charge arrangements when required. The role also uses workforce data and analytics to identify emerging people risks, staffing requirements and service-delivery bottlenecks, and to support evidence-based decisions by senior management.

item.title: Deputy Representative Operations (P-4) Temporary Appointment/TA, 6 months, position #138620, Bissau, Guinea-Bissau, WCAR
item.description: An exciting and challenging opportunity is now available within the UNICEF Guinea-Bissau Country Office for a highly motivated and dedicated Deputy Representative, Operations (P-4). The Operations function is a strategic Business Partner role within the Senior Management Team, assuring the best use of UNICEF assets in alignment with sound management practices, office priorities and goals to deliver results for children. The function supports the Head of the Office on managing the office and monitoring operations and programmes as needed while providing advice on best and innovative management practices to enhance office performance.

item.title: Chief WASH, P-4, FT, #011313, Ouagadougou -Burkina-Faso, WCAR
item.description: The Water, Sanitation and Hygiene (WASH) programme is a core component of UNICEF Burkina Faso’s Country Programme, implemented in a context marked by insecurity, climate shocks and large‑scale internal displacement. The programme focuses on delivering life‑saving and resilient WASH services while strengthening national and sub‑national systems to ensure equitable, sustainable access for the most vulnerable women and children, particularly in fragile and hard‑to‑reach areas.

item.title: Chief Social Policy, P-4, FT, #085946 Ouagadougou - Burkina-Faso, WCAR
item.description: UNICEF Burkina Faso is seeking a highly qualified and experienced professional to join the team as Chief Social Policy. The incumbent will provide strategic leadership and technical guidance to advance social policy priorities, including social protection, public finance for children, child poverty and equity, and evidence-based policy advocacy.

item.title: Health Manager (Immunization, Health Systems and Health Emergencies), (P-4), FT, #00046937, Addis Ababa - Ethiopia, ESAR
item.description: UNICEF Ethiopia is seeking a highly qualified health professional to support the delivery of equitable and resilient health services for women and children. Operating within a decentralized and complex environment, the role will contribute to strengthening primary health care, immunization, health systems, and emergency preparedness and response, with a particular focus on reaching underserved, hard-to-reach, and crisis-affected populations across Ethiopia.

item.title: Roster of national and international experts in Child Protection in Emergencies, UNICEF Myanmar (In-person or Remote)
item.description: UNICEF’s Myanmar Child Protection Section seeks to maintain a roster of qualified experts to provide technical support for Child Protection in Emergencies (CPiE) in the following 2 thematic areas: 1. Mental Health and Psychosocial Support (MHPSS) 2. Unaccompanied and Separated Children (UASC) Interested applicants with relevant qualifications and experience are eligible to apply.

item.title: Contracts Specialist (P-3), FT, # 00125937, Kabul – Afghanistan, APR (only open to Non-Afghan nationals)
item.description: Unicef Afghanistan Country Office is looking for an experienced Contract Specialist responsible for planning, developing, and executing effective and efficient procurement of institutional services for the Country Office and ensuring that the contracting function produces affordable and quality outputs with a significant impact on program delivery of much-needed services.

item.title: Coordinator (Education Programme – Acceleration Facility) (P-3), Temporary Appointment, 364 days #00138424, Education Cannot Wait (ECW) - Geneva, Switzerland
item.description: ECW is looking for a qualified and experienced Coordinator who will lead the strategic management of ECW's Acceleration Facility, the Fund's catalytic investment window that supports the development and uptake of global public goods, innovation, and systems strengthening in education in emergencies and protracted crises (EiEPC).

item.title: Security Specialist, P-3, Fixed Term (2 years), Pemba, Mozambique, #00113729
item.description: UNICEF Mozambique is seeking a Security Specialist, P3, based in Pemba Field Office, to provide strategic and operational security support in a complex and volatile humanitarian environment. The role will advise senior management on security risk management, support safe programme delivery, strengthen humanitarian access, and coordinate closely with UNDSS, UN agencies, authorities, NGOs and implementing partners. The incumbent will provide security analysis, incident response, emergency preparedness, staff security guidance and capacity building to enable UNICEF to deliver timely and principled support to children and communities affected by conflict, displacement and climate-related emergencies in northern Mozambique.

item.description: UNICEF está buscando un Consultor/a para actualizar y modernizar integralmente el Plan Nacional para la Prevención, Detección Temprana, Control y Erradicación de la Influenza Aviaria en Honduras (2007) bajo estándares técnicos internacionales, integrando el enfoque multisectorial "Una Salud".

item.title: Digital Impact Manager, P-4, Fixed Term Position, Kampala, Uganda, #00051311
item.description: Lead digital innovation. Strengthen systems. Transform outcomes for children.UNICEF Uganda is seeking a visionary Digital Impact Manager to lead innovation and digital transformation across programme and operations. You will harness technology, data and strategic partnerships to scale effective solutions, strengthen national systems, enhance organizational effectiveness and accelerate sustainable results for children.Ready to turn digital ambition into lasting impact? Join UNICEF Uganda and help reimagine what is possible for every child. Apply now.

item.title: Chief (Professional Practices), P-5, Fixed Term, #00114284, Office of Internal Audit & Investigation, NYHQ
item.description: Join UNICEF as Chief (Professional Practices), Internal Audit. Lead the strategy, quality, innovation, and transformation of UNICEF’s global internal audit function, driving risk-based assurance, audit excellence, and data-driven insights across a complex international organization. This senior leadership role is ideal for a seasoned audit professional with extensive experience in internal audit, risk management, quality assurance, and audit modernization who is passionate about strengthening governance and organizational impact.

item.title: Finance Specialist (Supply Financing), P-3, Fixed Term Position, Copenhagen, Supply Division #00116964
item.description: The Supply Financing Specialist will be based at UNICEF Supply Division, and will support the implementation of the UNICEF Supply Division’s Financing Partnerships and Solutions Strategy (which focuses on supporting governments’ mobilization of domestic resources to buy essential supplies while “bridging” timing gaps in government or grant disbursements of Ministries of Health and Finance, development partners, as well as to build new financing opportunities, partnerships and solutions to support the provision of essential supplies and accelerate results for children) related to supply financing activities with respect to other programmes / challenges, especially resource mobilization by national budgets, market dynamics, accessing financing instruments, such as the Vaccine Independence Initiative (“VII”) revolving fund.

item.title: Representative, D-2, Kabul, Afghanistan
item.description: The Representative serves as the accredited representative of UNICEF in the country and reports to the Regional Director for general direction and oversight. The Representative is responsible for establishing dialogue with the Government to develop the framework of cooperation in the country and for working closely and collaboratively with the Government and national institutions, stakeholders and partners, to develop the Government-UNICEF Country Programme of Cooperation in active support of efforts to advance children’s rights as established under the Convention on the Rights of the Child, other international treaties/frameworks, the SDGs, and UN intergovernmental bodies.
